packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all non-major updates. main must be up to date to merge, so separate PRs made each other rebase and re-run CI one by one.
A new Python minor needs wheels for every backend dependency (3.15 broke watchfiles). Move Python by hand after checking them.
Playwright 1.59 cannot install Chromium on Ubuntu 26.04, so the E2E job stays on ubuntu-24.04. Remove once a Playwright release supports 26.04.
TypeScript 7 drops the API Nx's lockfile plugin calls (readConfigFile). Re-enable once Nx supports TypeScript 7.
